255 - 105 = 150 days into 1500.  
1500 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and by 100 but also by 400? 1500 not divisible by 400, so not leap in Gregorian; but proleptic Gregorian before 1582 still uses divisible-by-4 rule for Julian? The problem says "Use Gregorian calendar arithmetic" — so strictly Gregorian: century years not divisible by 400 are not leap).  
So 1500 is NOT a leap year.
